name: table-sort-paginator
description: Wires MatTable to MatSort and MatPaginator through a shared MatTableDataSource — the standard pattern for a sortable, paginated data table.
templateCode: Name {{ row.name }} Value {{ row.value }}
notes: Assign dataSource.sort and dataSource.paginator inside ngAfterViewInit, not the constructor — the child directives aren't rendered yet at that point.
MatTableDataSource's built-in sort compares values by the matSortActive column name directly; override sortingDataAccessor for nested or computed properties.
Keep pageSize in sync with one of the pageSizeOptions values, or Angular can throw an ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError in dev mode.
